strata.selection_rule: Lowest case ID tagged complete + low_severity + explicit_negative
strata.purpose: Shortest complete baseline with explicit negative pathway entry findings

strata.selection_rule: Lowest case ID tagged complete + bronchodilator_reassessment + complete_post_reassessment
strata.purpose: Pre-treatment and post-treatment measurements in one stateful respiratory assessment

strata.selection_rule: Highest known-observation count among complete + all_pathways cases without urgent action; tie by case ID
strata.purpose: Longest non-urgent whole-encounter synthesis across all four supported pathways

strata.selection_rule: Highest known-observation count among complete + all_pathways cases with urgent action; tie by case ID
strata.purpose: Urgent finding plus complete holistic assessment and simultaneous classifications

strata.selection_rule: Highest known-observation count among cases tagged incomplete + multiple_omissions; tie by case ID
strata.purpose: Unknown preservation across multiple incomplete assessment groups

strata.selection_rule: Lowest case ID tagged incomplete + urgent_incomplete
strata.purpose: Known urgent finding while final holistic synthesis remains withheld
